description:
Find companies by name in the official registers of France, Spain and United Kingdom, 10 per page.
Use it when you know a name but no ID, then call lookup_company or verify_company with an ID from the results. Don't use it when you already have an official ID.
Inputs: country FR or ES or GB; query, 2 to 200 characters ('telefonica'). Optional: postal_code, locality, status, jurisdiction (regional registers), page, format; limit (up to 100 rows) with a file format.
Returns: best match first, each with match.score (0-1) and reasons, name, status, address, IDs, provenance; meta.next_page.
Limits: 2 units a page; files 2 per started 25 rows. Read-only. France: insolvency from BODACC since 2008. Public contracts won since 2024 (DECP, weekly). Spain: BORME acts since 2 January 2009. UK: no officers or PSCs. No person's name in any answer.
Search words: SIREN, RCS, Annuaire des Entreprises, société; BORME, Registro Mercantil, empresa, sociedad; Companies House, company number, Ltd, plc, LLP, KYB, supplier check.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

format.description: Answer format: json (default); csv, tsv, markdown, html (table), xml or ndjson come back inline, one row per company with source and fetched_at; xlsx or parquet as a download link valid 24 hours. Same units; search takes limit (up to 100 rows) with a non-json format.
format.title: Format

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 region to search in, for countries with regional registers (list_coverage lists them).
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

limit.description: Rows in one file, up to 100, with a non-json format only. 2 units per started 25 rows (100 rows = 8 units).
limit.title: Limit

name: search_companies
title: Search companies by name
